evaluation_only.independent_numeric_oracle: RMS from float64 raw slices; PSD/Event bandpower from independent raw-sample Welch and band integration; event inclusion from exact onset-relative bounds; compare recomputed operands
evaluation_only.scope: all numerical fields and source/record/window/units/processing/version necessary to original user request; task_id alone is insufficient
evaluation_only.answer_scoring: independent oracle plus explicit complete/partial/stop classification; no LLM self-scoring; preserve ambiguity for manual audit
evaluation_only.history_use: same actual result/field or artifact in a later operation is usage evidence; restored content merely appearing is not usage; causal benefit requires paired/ablation evidence

paired_run_policy.unit: one complete case conversation across A/B/C from fresh independent stores over identical synthetic samples
paired_run_policy.shared_planner_track: one model-generated DAG from only the natural request may be replayed identically across arms for mechanism isolation; include shared planning cost amortized equally, separately report any autonomous replanning; this is not independent end-to-end planning accuracy
paired_run_policy.end_to_end_track: each arm sees only the original natural requests and metadata; planner proposes DAG and Executor chooses local actions; no evaluator DAG/ID/order; distinguish planner variation from memory effect
paired_run_policy.development_vs_confirmation: development traces may guide bounded revisions; freeze code/protocol/data/model before a single confirmation per unit; do not select best repeated run
paired_run_policy.budget: 0 currently; require a new explicit authorization and append-only ledger; preflight whole paired unit including final answer, fail before starting if full unit cannot fit
paired_run_policy.interruption: retain attempted and unattempted arms; an incomplete paired unit is not a candidate success; no paid retry without fresh within-stage reservation
paired_run_policy.stopping: if baseline and candidate equally reliable, do not add complexity to manufacture separation; report short-task cost and equivalent-baseline sensitivity

proposed_paid_validation_not_authorized.why: two complementary complete three-arm conversations cover mixed-object clarification/artifact continuation and stable revision/old-new comparison
proposed_paid_validation_not_authorized.token_budget_condition: derive from measured complete A/B/C wire trajectories plus reserved final views and bounded model actions; publish measured required ceiling before seeking authorization; no guessed monetary amount
proposed_paid_validation_not_authorized.later_units: Only after first complete paired units are scientifically usable, separately authorize remaining cases/ablations; no old budget transfer
